import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/t')
from run import run

def mk(parts):
    c=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}],
        "expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h.example"}}]
    return {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":c,"events":[],
            "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":p} for p in parts]}]}

def probe(label, parts):
    out = run(mk(parts))
    if 'error' in out:
        print('%-34s -> INPUT ERROR' % label); return
    ch=out['channels'][0]
    print('%-34s -> err=%s reqs=%d bytes=%d' % (label, ch['error'], len(ch['requests']), ch['bytes']['n']))

head = "GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\n"
def line(n):
    s = "X: " + "a"*(n-5) + "\r\n"
    assert len(s) == n, (len(s), n)
    return s

lines = [line(605) for _ in range(108)]
prefix = head + "".join(lines)
# block size = request line(18) + header lines + final empty line(2)
used = len(prefix) + 2
lastlen = 65536 - used
body = line(lastlen) + "\r\n"
total = len(prefix) + len(body)
probe("block %d" % total, [head, body])
body2 = line(lastlen+1) + "\r\n"
probe("block %d" % (len(prefix)+len(body2)), [head, body2])
